description: Évolution des énergies renouvelables raccordées au réseau SRD - depuis 2008 is a dataset listed in SRD OpenData open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by SRD. Évolution des énergies renouvelables raccordées au réseau SRD depuis 2008 Agrégat des filières de production: ÉOLIEN / SOLAIRE / BIOGAZ / MÉTHANISATION / HYDRAULIQUE Attention: ce jeu de données est publié annuellement (données actualisées au dernier jour de l'année A-1). Coverage: Vienne (SRD electricity network). The portal files it under Production et stockage. Its keywords are Point d'injection, Puissance de raccordement, Productible, Statistiques annuelles. The portal shows 14 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2024-05-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte version 2.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-srd-energies-fr-portal.
